messages:
sam: noticing elevated error-rate (client 5xx) for model rwi-llama-lite on runtime 2.7.0 in ap-northeast starting ~02:03 UTC. small but steady.
lina: thanks sam. did runtime 2.7.0 fully roll last night?
infra: yes rollout completed 01:50 UTC. can reproduce a handful of traces showing timeouts during kv-cache flush path.
deploybot: Deploybot: Compatibility alert: model=rwi-llama-lite runtime=2.7.0 region=ap-northeast. Suggested mitigations: 1) regional pin to runtime 2.6.9, 2) enable safelist routing for low-qps customers, 3) create rollback lane. Use `/deploy pin --model rwi-llama-lite --runtime 2.6.9 --region ap-northeast --duration 24h --reason "kv-cache-timeout-spike"`
sam: prefer targeted pin + safelist. avoid global rollback; we'll triage traces first.
qa-bot: QA-bot: queued quick smoke regression for longseq and streaming (job rq-7801), ETA 12m.
sre-oncall: creating rollback lane and an automated monitor: if errors >= 1.5x baseline for 10m -> re-pin.
deploybot: Deploybot: Pin executed (task 110045). Safelist rule applied (customers <3qps -> runtime 2.6.9). Rollback lane rb-110045 created.
infra: uploaded sampled traces to ticket INF-5502. looks like flush sleep timer under 2.7.0 sometimes blocks other requests.
lina: can infra try a small patch to increase flush concurrency? if feasible we can test on canary.
infra: small patch prepared, will deploy to a canary pool in ap-northeast within 30m.
sam: great. monitor pinned cohort latency while patch is validated. if patch helps, we can plan unpin with phased rollout.
qa-bot: regression done: no functional regressions found in sampled prompts.
sre-oncall: telemetry: pinned cohort error-rate dropped from 0.9% -> 0.2%, p99 improved. keeping watch for 2h.
lina: drafting release-note line: "ap-northeast: temporary regional pin of rwi-llama-lite to runtime 2.6.9 while investigating kv-cache timeout regression in 2.7.0."
sam: ok closing coordination thread, keep updates here. ping #oncall if rollback triggers. :white_check_mark:
